Record Class OrderTemplateItem

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.template.OrderTemplateItem
Record Components:
templateId - the template
name - its name
side - BUY or SELL
orderType - MARKET, LIMIT, STOP, STOP_LIMIT or TRAILING_STOP
timeInForce - DAY or GTC
limitOffsetPercent - the limit price as signed percent from the market, if the type has one
stopOffsetPercent - the stop price as signed percent from the market, if the type has one
trailPercent - a trailing stop's trail in percent
takeProfitPercent - a bracket's take-profit, percent above the entry price
stopLossPercent - a bracket's stop-loss, percent below the entry price
createdAt - when it was saved
public record OrderTemplateItem(UUID templateId, String name, String side, String orderType, String timeInForce, BigDecimal limitOffsetPercent, BigDecimal stopOffsetPercent, BigDecimal trailPercent, BigDecimal takeProfitPercent, BigDecimal stopLossPercent, OffsetDateTime createdAt) extends Record
A saved ticket setup, as listed to its owner.
